source: FRED API + NY Fed ACM + ICE BofA MOVE (via Yahoo)
method: Deterministic level/20-day-change checks against the 2022-10 and 2023-10 long-end bottoms; valuation boxes use the 2023 levels, timing boxes need elevated MOVE and a stalled front end (no LLM).

summary.read: 3 of 3 valuation boxes and 1 of 2 timing boxes checked; bottoms have needed the timing boxes.

indicators.name: 10y TIPS real yield
indicators.note: Real yield is the cleanest valuation anchor; the 2023 bottom printed 2.52.

indicators.name: ACM 10y term premium
indicators.note: Term premium is the compensation for duration risk; it was 0.45 at the 2023 bottom and negative at the 2022 one.

indicators.name: 10y breakeven inflation (not an inflation panic)
indicators.note: A long-end bottom needs the selloff to be about term premium, not a repricing of inflation; breakevens must not be running.

indicators.name: MOVE index (rates vol)
indicators.note: Both bottoms came with rates vol elevated; a calm MOVE says the flush has not happened yet.

indicators.name: Front end stalling while long end makes highs
indicators.rule: DGS2 >= 0.05pp below its 20d max while DGS30 within 0.05pp of its 20d max
indicators.detail: 2y 4.84 is 0.08pp below its 20d max 4.92; 30y 5.66 is 0.00pp below its 20d max 5.66
indicators.note: At both bottoms the 2y had stopped rising while the 30y was still printing highs: the steepening that marks the end of a long-end selloff.

indicators.name: 10y Treasury yield
indicators.note: Level of the benchmark long rate.

indicators.name: Curve slope (10y - 2y)
indicators.note: Bear steepening is the long-end selloff signature; its reversal marks a bottom.

indicators.name: 5s30s slope (30y - 5y)
indicators.note: Belly-to-long slope isolates term premium from the policy path.

indicators.name: 30y mortgage rate (weekly)
indicators.note: Where the long end bites the real economy.
